operating_notes.text: Coforge launched two AI-native solutions for airlines: Voyager.AI for personalization and Flightflex.AI for disruption recovery.
Coforge completed the acquisition of Encora US Holdco and Encora Holdings, issuing 9.38 crore shares and taking a USD 550 million loan.
Coforge secured a USD 550 million three-year loan at 4.6% fixed interest to fund the Encora acquisition, dropping QIP plans.
Coforge positioned as a Leader and Star Performer in Everest Group's Duck Creek Services PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026, backed by over 1,200 certified professionals.
NCLT sanctioned amalgamation of Cigniti Technologies with Coforge Limited with appointed date April 1, 2025.
FY26 revenue reached ₹16,421 Mn / $1,870 Mn, up 35.9% YoY in INR terms.
Launched Nexa Agentic AI Platform for insurance operations with 30+ insurance AI assets.
Allotted 1,26,71,602 equity shares pursuant to Cigniti amalgamation scheme.
Inaugurated the fourth Coforge Public Library in Vasant Kunj, New Delhi, spanning 10,000 sq. ft. with over 15,000 titles.
Digital Mobile Innovations Italy S.R.L. was liquidated to streamline operations.

timeline.summary: Coforge launched two AI-native solutions, Voyager.AI and Flightflex.AI, for global airlines on April 21, 2026.
Coforge completed the acquisition of Encora, issuing 9.38 crore shares and securing a USD 550 million loan facility.
Coforge announced the successful closure of the Encora acquisition, securing a USD 550 million loan and calling off QIP plans.
Coforge was positioned as a Leader and Star Performer in Everest Group's Duck Creek Services PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026 on April 28, 2026.
NCLT Chandigarh Bench approved the Scheme of Amalgamation of Cigniti Technologies with Coforge Limited with a 1:1 swap ratio.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹4,450.4 Cr, net profit ₹666.2 Cr.
Coforge reported FY26 revenue of ₹16,421 Cr, up 35.9% YoY, with an EBIT margin of 14.4%.
Coforge set May 16, 2026 as the record date for issuing equity shares under the Cigniti amalgamation scheme.
Coforge launched Aeronova.AI on May 21, 2026, to assist airlines in modernizing retailing capabilities to OOSD operations.
Coforge received in-principle stock exchange listing approval for preferential issue shares on May 22, 2026.
Coforge launched the Nexa Agentic AI Platform on June 2, 2026, targeting global insurance operations.
Coforge allotted 1,26,71,602 equity shares to Cigniti shareholders on June 3, 2026, pursuant to the amalgamation scheme.
Coforge opened its fourth public library in Vasant Kunj, New Delhi, on June 5, 2026.
H1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹11,698.5 Cr, net profit ₹1,136.6 Cr.
Coforge completed the voluntary liquidation and formal dissolution of its dormant Italian step-down subsidiary, Digital Mobile Innovations Italy S.R.L.
Coforge announced the proposed appointment of Price Waterhouse Chartered Accountants LLP as statutory auditors for a 5-year term starting from the 35th AGM in 2027.
